results.title: Son of the Soil
results.overview: Nigerian soldier Zion Ladejo, haunted by his past, returns home after his sister's tragic death. Determined to uncover those responsible, he embarks on a vengeful path, while seeking redemption for his own actions.

results.title: Kindred
results.overview: A pair of young criminals break into a wealthy couple’s mansion and soon find out that the middle aged couple are much more dangerous than they appear to be.

results.title: The Madman
results.overview: Two men find themselves in a tense standoff on a packed commuter train in 1970s Jaipur, India. While the railways had been vital arteries of the nation since the 1890s, those engines were slowly falling into disrepair. In just under a year, the Bangladesh War for Independence would begin, and as one historian put it: "A journey on the rails of Bengal in 1971 was often a melancholy affair."

results.title: Mirror Life
results.overview: Amidst a pandemic, a woman documents the search for her cousin who disappeared after entering a clinical trial for an experimental miracle drug called Dumitor.

results.title: Depronima
results.overview: When a night of celebration spirals into a haunting blur of music, shadows, and unspoken desires, a close-knit group of friends is forced to confront their deepest fears as one of them sinks further into the darkness of his own pain.

results.title: Westlife 25: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
results.original_title: Westlife 25: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
results.overview: Experience an unforgettable celebration as for the first time ever, Westlife take centre stage at London’s iconic Royal Albert Hall for a fun-filled night of nostalgia honouring 25 magnificent years of chart-topping music. Selling over 55 millions records worldwide and with an incredible 14 No.1 singles, Westlife have established themselves as a defining force within pop and one of the world’s biggest bands of the 21st century. To mark their 25th anniversary, the band will be joined by the renowned Royal Philharmonic Concert Orchestra, bringing Westlife’s biggest hits and fan favourites like Flying Without Wings, Your Raise Me Up and Uptown Girl to life like never before and with the glittering Gatsby-themed stage, this event promises a visual and musical feast for fans and newcomers alike. This is not just a concert — it's a cinematic celebration of a legendary band and their enduring legacy.

results.title: KCW: Giallo
results.overview: The Deathwolf Alton Thorne teams up with old rival BA Rose to seek retribution against NXT LVL.

results.title: ROH Supercard of Honor 2025
results.overview: Supercard of Honor 2025 was a professional wrestling event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH), which took place on July 11, 2025 at Esports Stadium Arlington in Arlington, Texas. The show was headlined by Bandido (c) vs. Konosuke Takeshita for the ROH World Championship.

results.title: Rezbotanik
results.overview: After nights of heavy partying, a trans performer goes to the Botanical Garden of Lisbon to sober up again.

results.title: Chooch
results.overview: A low-level thug is ordered to kill a man. Hesitant to pull the trigger, he visits his best friend, a reformed gangster, seeking advice

results.title: Burnt Toast
results.overview: A seedy virus is spreadding... is a digital epidemic closer than we think?

results.title: Baby Blues - Going Dark
results.overview: Barney needs a tooth out. His regular dentist is not in the office, but that's OK -- Dr Carroway and her assistant Penny will take care of him today ... He really should have rescheduled. This is not going to go well, especially after the power goes out.

results.title: Aslan Hürkuş 4: Hürjet Oyunda
results.overview: The story of Aslan and his friends, who find themselves on a planet called Minigen after a portal opens as a result of an accident, and Hürkuş and Hürjet, who embark on an adventure to find them.

results.title: The Instinct
results.overview: A home invasion thriller starring a dog trainer trying to modify a human's brain.

results.title: Maareesan
results.overview: A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.

results.title: Lapo Chapé
results.overview: The term "Lapo Chapé", derived from Martinican Creole, means "the skin color that escapes the status of a slave." This documentary thus explores the themes of skin color and mixed heritage from a unique perspective, through a series of testimonies that shed light on the invisible influences of history. These influences have shaped our social representations and continue to challenge our perceptions of identity today.

results.title: The Holy Gram
results.overview: Two lives, two lines, two friends… Olga and Fabiana are exactly that. Two close companions navigating a world where they seek approval from men to feel accepted—only to be weighed down by guilt afterward. Can they save the world while completely out of it? They certainly believe so. A tribute to those rare, sharp moments of clarity that strike when everything else is a blur.

results.title: After The Defeat
results.overview: Four thirty-somethings with dreams to achieve, after their respective personal failures, find refuge in the home of a social misfit. They soon realize that this apartment and these relationships are an opportunity to rebuild their world.

results.title: Leave Me Alone
results.overview: A British-Pakistani must confront her ancestral trauma head-on when she is haunted by a malevolent spirit seeking retribution for colonial atrocities in British India.
